title: RBI to conduct Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on August 10, 2026
description: On a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions, it has been decided to conduct a second Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction on Monday, August 10, 2026, as under: Sl. No. Notified Amount (₹ crore) Tenor(day) Window Timing Date of Reversal 1 1,00,000 1 12:00 Noon to 12:30 PM August 11, 2026 (Tuesday) 2. The operational guidelines for the auction as given in the Reserve Bank’s Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020 will remain the same.Ajit Prasad &nbs
